channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ICE Whistleblower Alerts to 'Unprecedented Lowering of Standards' in Hiring Surge
item.description: A supervisor in charge of background checks warned last year that ICE was hiring numerous new officers without basic vetting procedures.

item.title: Stock market strength creates record number of 401(k) millionaires
item.description: Fidelity reported a record 769,000 401(k) accounts with balances over $1 million in the second quarter.

item.title: White House site introduces retro arcade games promoting Trump agenda
item.description: The White House website launched Arcade, a set of five simple video games highlighting different aspects of President Donald Trump's policies.

item.title: Two workers rescued from Nepal tunnel nine days after flooding
item.description: Rescuers in Nepal freed two workers from a hydropower tunnel, while efforts continue to locate others still trapped.
